tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: warm paper, warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Second paper: sidebar, code, logs, floating panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, rows and notes; the margin rule. Separators only (1.3:1 on `paper`): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Edges of controls: fields, icon buttons on hover. 3.4:1 or more on `paper` and `surface` in light, 3.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the numbers that matter. 16:1 on `paper` (light), 13.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, facts, axes, icons at rest. ≥5.3:1 on `paper` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, ink blue: links, focus, selection, running, the text of buttons. 6.3:1 / 7.0:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Pass, confirmed, finished. Always with an icon and a word. 4.7:1 / 7.1:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Fail, refuted, failed runs, errors in place. 5.1:1 / 5.9:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Inconclusive, killed, stale. Always with an icon and a word. 5.3:1 / 7.5:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Run 1 of 6 (blue), drawn solid. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Run 2 of 6 (orange), drawn dashed. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Run 3 of 6 (dark green), drawn dotted. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Run 4 of 6 (violet), drawn dash-dot. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Run 5 of 6 (magenta), drawn short dashes. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Run 6 of 6 (teal), drawn long dashes. 3.0–7.1:1 on light `paper`, 4.1–9.9:1 on dark; lightness differs from its neighbours so runs stay apart without hue.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Block titles, note titles in a list.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Warmup shortens the time to a stable loss.
styles.usage: A proposal statement, the largest serif on the page: italic means proposed.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: All 9 runs with warmup ≥ 300 stay under a grad-norm of 10.
styles.usage: What people and agents write: notes, memory, rationale.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Numbered captions under tables and figures.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Labels, table headers, status words, crumbs, meta.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside rows and controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related items; cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, panels, row tints.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Width of the Section margin, where labels sit.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Space around a Section's content: above, below and after the margin rule.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of prose.

tokens.name: measure-short
tokens.usage: Longest line of a statement.

dash.note: Line styles for runs, as SVG stroke-dasharray: run n is drawn in data-n with dash-n, so curves stay apart in grayscale and for color-blind readers.

tokens.name: dash-1
tokens.usage: Run 1: solid.

tokens.name: dash-2
tokens.usage: Run 2: dashed.

tokens.name: dash-3
tokens.usage: Run 3: dotted.

tokens.name: dash-4
tokens.usage: Run 4: dash-dot.

tokens.name: dash-5
tokens.usage: Run 5: short dashes.

tokens.name: dash-6
tokens.usage: Run 6: long dashes.

tokens.name: stroke-data
tokens.usage: Curve width in charts.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the margin rule.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke, with square caps and mitred joins.
